topCaption: Top viewers ranked by loyalty points
description: Your channel’s own currency: viewers earn it by subscribing, cheering, and watching.
degraded: Loyalty settings are temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
botOnHint: Master switch: nobody earns points while this is off.
ratesHint: Use each switch to turn a source off. The number is what a viewer earns for it. The tag shows the default.
streamerPointsHint: Allow the channel owner to earn automatic points, including watch points while present in chat during a live stream. Watch time, transfers and manual grants remain available when off.
tierHint: Sub and resub awards scale with the tier: ×1, ×2 (tier 2), ×6 (tier 3).
topEmpty: No standings yet. They appear once viewers start earning.
chatPoints: Viewers check their balance and watch time.
chatGive: Anyone can give their OWN points to another viewer (toggle below).
chatPointsMod: Mods set, grant or remove a viewer's points. Toggle each capability above.
chatCounter: Mods manage counters (also on the Counters page).
permissionsHint: Choose exactly what moderators may do with points from chat. The channel owner always keeps full control.
permSetHint: Mods may run !points set @user <amount> to write an exact balance.
permAdjustHint: Mods may run !points add/remove @user <amount> to shift a balance up or down.
permTransfersHint: !points give @user <amount> moves the sender's own points. Applies to mods and viewers alike.
gamesHint: Gamble and duels spend this currency. Odds and chat lines stay on each game’s page. This is only the on-switch.
gamesNeedsOn: Turn loyalty on before these games can run.
errRate: Enter a whole number from 1 to {max}.
